current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，该方法结合图摘要技术和图自编码器，并利用循环神经网络学习时间维度的特征与依赖关系，能够高效生成大规模动态时序图的表征，显著降低内存消耗和训练时间。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which combines graph summarization with graph autoencoder and uses recurrent neural networks to learn temporal features and dependencies, enabling efficient representation generation for large-scale dynamic graphs with significantly reduced memory consumption and training time.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻上原图快照的序列
利用图摘要技术对原图进行压缩，将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，通过重构误差训练原图节点的表征
引入循环神经网络作为时序学习模块，学习原图在时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
在四个真实世界大规模图数据集上验证，平均内存消耗和平均训练时长分别仅为传统图神经网络算法的9.86%和13.27%
technical_features_en: Modeling dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each moment
Compressing the original graph via graph summarization and feeding the compressed graph into a graph autoencoder, using reconstruction error to train node representations of the original graph
Introducing a recurrent neural network as the time sequence learning module to learn feature information and dependencies of the original graph in the temporal dimension

Extensive experiments on four real-world large-scale graph datasets demonstrate that average memory consumption and average training time are only 9.86% and 13.27% of those of traditional graph neural network algorithms
